Patch the real Discord app.

Pick an installed Discord APK: Nebula injects its loader and your enabled plugins into Discord's own React Native bundle, rebuilds the container with Android's alignment rules, signs the result, and reports whether the signature verifies.

The patched build uses a different signing key than the official app, so Android treats it as a separate install: uninstall the official Discord first, and expect to sign in again.

A build that ships Hermes bytecode instead of a JavaScript bundle is refused with an explanation rather than producing an app that crashes.
